chapters.label: Paris 2024
chapters.text: Olympic final, 2024: Spain against France in Paris. Juan Miranda drives the ball across from the left. Who is arriving? Fermín López! Two-one to Spain.

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Fermín runs from midfield into the box, right on time, and taps it in: his second goal of the final! Spain won gold, five-three.

chapters.label: How he does it
chapters.text: How does he do it? Pass to a teammate, then keep running forward. Defenders watch the ball, not you. So remember: keep running forward after you pass. The return ball can find you free!
